base_text: Ten different people describe how they coped after a financial crisis; most became homeless, a few did not.
note: Sampled from world_model.json (seed 0). Each story mentions only the events that actually happened to that person. Aggregation target = marginal edge frequencies: crisis->rent 9/10, rent->eviction 7/10, eviction->homeless 7/10, homeless->health 5/10. 3 of 10 averted homelessness (p3 chain didn't fire, p6 no rent trouble, p8 protected by support).

variants.text: When my hours were cut at work I couldn't keep up with the rent. I fell behind, got evicted, and ended up sleeping rough. Months on the street have left me ill most of the time.
After the plant closed I lost my income and the rent piled up. The landlord evicted me, and I have been homeless ever since; my health has fallen apart out here.
A sudden illness stopped me working and I couldn't pay the rent. I was evicted within weeks, ended up on the streets, and my body has been breaking down ever since.

variants.perspective: p3: car broke down -> AVERTED (kept flat)
variants.text: When my car broke down I suddenly couldn't cover both the repairs and the rent, and I fell behind for a couple of months. It was tight and stressful, but I caught up before it went any further and kept my flat.

variants.perspective: p4: lost job -> homeless (no health decline)
variants.text: Losing my job meant I couldn't make rent, and after a few missed payments I was evicted. I have been homeless since, sleeping in a shelter when I can get a bed.
A messy divorce left me unable to afford the flat on my own. I got behind, was evicted, and ended up on the street, where my health has steadily got worse.

variants.perspective: p6: medical bill scare -> AVERTED (never fell behind)
variants.text: I had a real scare when a big medical bill landed, and for a while I panicked about money. In the end I tightened everything up and never actually fell behind on the rent.
When my benefits were delayed the money ran out and I couldn't pay rent. The eviction came fast, I ended up homeless, and living outside has wrecked my health.

variants.perspective: p8: laid off + SUPPORT -> AVERTED (sister helped)
variants.text: After I was laid off I quickly fell behind on rent and thought I'd lose the flat. But my sister stepped in and covered a couple of months, so the eviction never happened and I stayed housed.

variants.perspective: p9: shifts dried up -> homeless (no health decline)
variants.text: When my shifts dried up I couldn't make rent, and the landlord had me out within a couple of months. I have been homeless since, staying at a hostel.
